endorsements.name: Mike Walker Dr. Arati Prabhakar
endorsements.label: DARPA Cyber Grand Challenge Award Ceremony
endorsements.description: On Friday morning, August 5th, DARPA will announce the prize winners and recognize the parties responsible for building and competing in the Cyber Grand Challenge (CGC), the world's first all-machine hacking tournament, which was completed August 4th. Seven high performance computers will have completed an all-machine Capture the Flag contest, reverse engineering unknown binary software, authoring new IDS signatures, probing the security of opponent software, and re-mixing defended services with machine-generated patches and defenses. Come hear about what transpired at CGC, and learn which team will be taking home the $2M grand prize, as well as the $1M second place and $750K third place prizes
